title: RegistryArtifact
description: Authoritative field-level payload schema for the RegistryArtifact family of UCOS-DATA-CONTRACT-027 (API-027 Registry). A RegistryArtifact is one versioned, registered unit of authoritative knowledge of what exists (LD-14 / PD-14 Registry). Field authority: UCOS-PDATA-ARCH-001. Fields are derived from the implemented Registry substrate (RegistryPort/RegistryRecord, meta-core/ports.ts, EV-PI23-BUILD VERIFIED) and API-027 operation intent; transport form deferred to Prompt 08, security controls deferred to Prompt 09.

schema.description: One registered artifact record. Realizes LDO-059 Artifact Descriptor / PDE-059.
Stable, unique artifact identifier. Source authority: RegistryRecord.id (meta-core/ports.ts).
Semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Source authority: RegistryRecord.version (SemVer, contracts/types.ts); versioning via Evolution (migration-only, IP-14/IP-15).
Artifact kind. Source authority: RegistryRecord.kind (meta-core/ports.ts) — the two registrable descriptor kinds.

The registered descriptor payload (CapabilityDescriptor | ContractDescriptor). Open object: internal shape is owned by the descriptor schemas (meta-core/descriptor-schemas.ts), not redefined here. Source authority: RegistryRecord.descriptor.
Directory the descriptor was loaded from (relative provider resolution). Source authority: RegistryRecord.sourceDir (optional).
Registration lifecycle state. Source authority: EVT-027 lifecycle events ArtifactRegistered / ArtifactSuperseded (UCOS-CONTRACT-CAT-001 §A).
